research_preview_warning: Candidate review status and Learn eligibility are temporarily adapted in memory only. This is not a scientific verification or permission to ship.
gate_capture_note: Each profile reports its first failing compiler assertion; numerical statistics remain available in compiled output. Existing release gates are not changed.

ranked_invariance.note: Ranked session storage key includes the global Chemle rules hash; changed hash archives previous sessions even when Ranked feedback and schedule are identical.

simulation_policy.learn_hints: automatic ladder only; no manual hint presses
simulation_policy.clue_model: exact published ladder text; scaffold smiles proxy for visible scaffold
simulation_policy.challenge: v0.3.2 spec and clue timings unless explicitly overridden; no narrative or manual hints
simulation_policy.lookahead: two-ply, best eight first probes by expected survivors; future clue reveals ignored during optimization
simulation_policy.tie_break: prefer possible answer then lexically first ID; no duplicate guesses; differs from production solver tie-breaking
simulation_policy.limitations: perfect knowledge of exact clue text and scaffold proxy; not human difficulty or experimental validation
